question: Can the independently reconstructed and proof-checked full Hamming-ball exclusion around the core-kick E=2 candidate be extended beyond certified radius eight while retaining LRAT only as a lossless compressed stream?

streaming_method.description: drat-trim writes LRAT through a FIFO into zstd; the retained archive is streamed through zstd decompression into lrat-check while the exact uncompressed byte count and SHA-256 are recomputed

checks: FIFO endpoints use explicit guards and readiness handshakes so a producer or consumer that fails before opening cannot leave the partner blocked in open().
The replay guard has no write end while lrat-check runs, so it cannot suppress EOF.
zstd has a pinned SHA-256 and each compression/decompression subprocess is bounded or explicitly terminated.
Checker acceptance requires an exact `s VERIFIED` or `c VERIFIED` line, a zero exit status, and successful replay transport.
SAT is reported only after an independent streaming DIMACS model replay; worker status, proof metadata, artifact aliases, and post-check hashes fail closed.
A fresh hardened control reproduced the historical DRAT, compressed LRAT, uncompressed LRAT hash, and 1806516-byte LRAT length exactly.

storage_preflight.measurement: df available bytes on the filesystem containing certificates/
storage_preflight.failure_action: Do not generate or solve that radius; record INFRASTRUCTURE_STORAGE_GATE and continue other research tracks.
storage_preflight.current_gate_status_at_preregistration: FAILED; available space was below 2 GiB

execution_rule: Process radii strictly in increasing order.
Pass the storage preflight before generating each formula.
For each radius, independently reconstruct every expected clause before solving.
Use the pinned streaming pipeline to produce DRAT, validate it with drat-trim, retain LRAT as zstd, and replay the exact decompressed LRAT through lrat-check.
After CERTIFIED_UNSAT, losslessly compress the CNF and DRAT, test each archive, and require decompression hashes to match the result record.
Continue after CERTIFIED_UNSAT only if the next storage preflight also passes.
Stop this ladder immediately after SAT, TIMEOUT, proof-check failure, metadata mismatch, or other infrastructure error.
Never infer the status of a larger radius from an unresolved or unrun smaller radius.

outcome_policy.SAT: Reconstruct the complete order-43 graph and require both independent graph verifiers before any lower-bound claim.
outcome_policy.UNSAT: Claim only the labeled full Hamming ball after formula reconstruction and both DRAT/LRAT checks accept.
outcome_policy.TIMEOUT_OR_ERROR: Record no SAT/UNSAT conclusion for that radius or any unrun larger radius.
outcome_policy.scope_warning: No Hamming-radius result is global order-43 nonexistence.
